mapper.sql: sequence_number,it_code_of_user,email, user_name,country,department, app.cmdb_id, app.application_name as app_name,user_id,user_id_valid_to, authorization_technical_name,authorization_description,authorization_valid_to, access_label,first_line_manager,second_line_manager, it_code_of_bpo,user_id_lock,access_review_decision,audit_trail, system_role,role_description, leit_system_id, leit_system_name, bpo,bpo_review_status,bpo_review_decision, line_manager,line_manager_review_status,line_managers_review_decision, final_review_decision,final_review_time,final_review_result_reason
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "all", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN final_review_decision is null and (line_manager_review_status = '1' OR bpo_review_status = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "pendingProcessing", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN final_review_decision is not null or (line_manager_review_status = '2' AND bpo_review_status = '2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "completed" FROM user_access_review WHERE it_code_of_user = #{itCodeOfUser} AND delete_flag = false

SELECT sequence_number, it_code_of_user, email, user_name, country, department, app.cmdb_id, app.application_name AS app_name, user_id, user_id_valid_to, authorization_technical_name, authorization_description, authorization_valid_to, first_line_manager, second_line_manager, it_code_of_bpo, user_id_lock, access_review_decision, audit_trail, system_role, role_description, leit_system_id, leit_system_name, line_manager, bpo, rm.access_label AS access_label,
CASE bpo_review_status WHEN '1' THEN '未审核' WHEN '2' THEN '已审核' ELSE COALESCE(bpo_review_status, '未知') END AS bpo_review_status,
CASE line_manager_review_status WHEN '1' THEN '未审核' WHEN '2' THEN '已审核' ELSE COALESCE(line_manager_review_status, '未知') END AS line_manager_review_status,
CASE bpo_review_status WHEN '1' THEN 'Pending Review' WHEN '2' THEN 'Reviewed' ELSE COALESCE(bpo_review_status, 'Unknown') END AS bpo_review_status,
CASE line_manager_review_status WHEN '1' THEN 'Pending Review' WHEN '2' THEN 'Reviewed' ELSE COALESCE(line_manager_review_status, 'Unknown') END AS line_manager_review_status,
CASE line_managers_review_decision WHEN 'keep' THEN '保留' WHEN 'remove' THEN '移除' ELSE line_managers_review_decision END AS line_managers_review_decision,
CASE bpo_review_decision WHEN 'keep' THEN '保留' WHEN 'remove' THEN '移除' ELSE bpo_review_decision END AS bpo_review_decision,
line_managers_review_decision, bpo_review_decision,
CASE final_review_decision WHEN 'keep' THEN '保留' WHEN 'remove' THEN '移除' ELSE final_review_decision END AS final_review_decision,
final_review_decision,
final_review_time, final_review_result_reason FROM user_access_review rm left join its_application_data app on rm.cmdb_id = app.cmdb_id
order by rm.sequence_number

SELECT
FROM user_access_review rm left join its_application_data app on rm.cmdb_id = app.cmdb_id
ORDER BY rm.sequence_number

email = #{item.email}, user_name = #{item.userName}, country = #{item.country}, department = #{item.department}, user_id = #{item.userId}, user_id_valid_to = #{item.userIdValidTo}, authorization_technical_name = #{item.authorizationTechnicalName}, authorization_description = #{item.authorizationDescription}, authorization_valid_to = #{item.authorizationValidTo}, access_label = #{item.accessLabel}, lineManager = #{item.lineManager}, second_line_manager = #{item.secondLineManager}, it_code_of_bpo = #{item.itCodeOfBpo}, bpo_review_decision = #{item.bpoReviewDecision}, user_id_lock = #{item.userIdLock}, access_review_decision = #{item.accessReviewDecision}, audit_trail = #{item.auditTrail}, role_description = #{item.roleDescription}, bpo_review_status = #{item.bpoReviewStatus},
line_manager_review_status = '2', line_managers_review_decision = #{item.lineManagersReviewDecision}, final_review_decision = #{item.finalReviewDecision},
WHERE sequence_number = #{item.sequenceNumber}
